1: // Minimal Stellar Drift game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
6: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
7: 
8: // Ship state
9: let ship = {
10:   x: canvas.width / 2,
11:   y: canvas.height / 2,
12:   angle: 0,
13:   vx: 0,
14:   vy: 0,
15:   radius: 10,
16: };
17: 
18: // Input handling
19: const keys = {};
20: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.code] = true));
21: window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
22: 
23: // Entities
24: let asteroids = [];
25: let orbs = [];
26: let score = 0;
27: let gameOver = false;
28: 
29: function spawnAsteroid() {
30:   const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
31:   let x, y, vx, vy;
32:   const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 1.5;
33:   switch (side) {
34:     case 0: // top
35:       x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
36:       y = -20;
37:       vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
38:       vy = speed;
39:       break;
40:     case 1: // bottom
41:       x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
42:       y = canvas.height + 20;
43:       vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
44:       vy = -speed;
45:       break;
46:     case 2: // left
47:       x = -20;
48:       y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
49:       vx = speed;
50:       vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
51:       break;
52:     case 3: // right
53:       x = canvas.width + 20;
54:       y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
55:       vx = -speed;
56:       vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
57:       break;
58:   }
59:   asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r: 15 + Math.random() * 10 });
60: }
61: 
62: function spawnOrb() {
63:   const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
64:   let x, y, vx, vy;
65:   const speed = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5;
66:   switch (side) {
67:     case 0:
68:       x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
69:       y = -10;
70:       vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
71:       vy = speed;
72:       break;
73:     case 1:
74:       x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
75:       y = canvas.height + 10;
76:       vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
77:       vy = -speed;
78:       break;
79:     case 2:
80:       x = -10;
81:       y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
82:       vx = speed;
83:       vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
84:       break;
85:     case 3:
86:       x = canvas.width + 10;
87:       y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
88:       vx = -speed;
89:       vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
90:       break;
91:   }
92:   orbs.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r: 5 });
93: }
94: 
95: // Simple collision test
96: function dist(ax, ay, bx, by) {
97:   return Math.hypot(ax - bx, ay - by);
98: }
99: 
100: function update(dt) {
101:   if (gameOver) return;
102:   // Controls
103:   if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= 0.12;
104:   if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += 0.12;
105:   if (keys['ArrowUp']) {
106:     const thrust = 0.08;
107:     ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * thrust;
108:     ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * thrust;
109:   }
110:   // Apply drift (slow friction)
111:   ship.vx *= 0.99;
112:   ship.vy *= 0.99;
113:   ship.x += ship.vx;
114:   ship.y += ship.vy;
115: 
116:   // Keep drifting off-screen detection
117:   if (
118:     ship.x < -30 || ship.x > canvas.width + 30 ||
119:     ship.y < -30 || ship.y > canvas.height + 30
120:   ) {
121:     gameOver = true;
122:   }
123: 
124:   // Update asteroids
125:   asteroids.forEach(a => {
126:     a.x += a.vx;
127:     a.y += a.vy;
128:     // off‑screen removal
129:     if (a.x < -40 || a.x > canvas.width + 40 || a.y < -40 || a.y > canvas.height + 40) {
130:       a.remove = true;
131:     }
132:     // Collision with ship
133:     if (dist(a.x, a.y, ship.x, ship.y) < a.r + ship.radius) {
134:       gameOver = true;
135:     }
136:   });
137:   asteroids = asteroids.filter(a => !a.remove);
138: 
139:   // Update orbs
140:   orbs.forEach(o => {
141:     o.x += o.vx;
142:     o.y += o.vy;
143:     if (o.x < -20 || o.x > canvas.width + 20 || o.y < -20 || o.y > canvas.height + 20) {
144:       o.remove = true;
145:     }
146:     if (dist(o.x, o.y, ship.x, ship.y) < o.r + ship.radius) {
147:       score += 1;
148:       o.remove = true;
149:     }
150:   });
151:   orbs = orbs.filter(o => !o.remove);
152: 
153:   // Random spawns
154:   if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
155:   if (Math.random() < 0.015) spawnOrb();
156: }
157: 
158: function draw() {
159:   ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
160:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
161: 
162:   // Ship
163:   ctx.save();
164:   ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
165:   ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
166:   ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
167:   ctx.beginPath();
168:   ctx.moveTo(12, 0);
169:   ctx.lineTo(-8, -6);
170:   ctx.lineTo(-8, 6);
171:   ctx.closePath();
172:   ctx.fill();
173:   ctx.restore();
174: 
175:   // Asteroids
176:   ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
177:   asteroids.forEach(a => {
178:     ctx.beginPath();
179:     ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
180:     ctx.fill();
181:   });
182: 
183:   // Orbs
184:   ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
185:   orbs.forEach(o => {
186:     ctx.beginPath();
187:     ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
188:     ctx.fill();
189:   });
190: 
191:   // UI
192:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
193:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
194:   ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
195:   if (gameOver) {
196:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
197:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
198:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
199:     ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
200:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
201:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
202:   }
203: }
204: 
205: let last = performance.now();
206: function loop(now) {
207:   const dt = now - last;
208:   last = now;
209:   update(dt);
210:   draw();
211:   if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
212: }
213: requestAnimationFrame(loop);
214: 
215: // Export for debugging (optional)
216: export { ship, asteroids, orbs, score, gameOver };

(End of file - total 216 lines)
